changeSet.author: bng-team
changeSet.comment: Make bng.audit_log append-only. The table is written to only by the write_audit_log trigger on bng.projects (one INSERT per project insert/update); nothing ever legitimately updates or deletes an audit row. Guard the table at the database level so no role can edit, delete or bulk-wipe history: a BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE row-level trigger and a BEFORE TRUNCATE statement-level trigger both raise insufficient_privilege. INSERT is left untouched, so the audit trigger keeps recording. This holds for every role — including the application role and the table owner — regardless of how table privileges are granted; the only way past it is to drop or disable the trigger, which is a deploy-time DDL action.

changeSet.author: bng-team
changeSet.comment: Least-privilege backstop for the append-only guard: revoke the mutating privileges on bng.audit_log from PUBLIC so no role inherits them by default. Non-application ("read-only") roles must be granted SELECT only; the application role needs SELECT, INSERT and never UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE. Per-role grants are provisioned by CDP infrastructure outside this changelog (see docs/DATABASE.md — Audit Log Immutability); this REVOKE ensures the default state is closed. Rollback is intentionally empty: PUBLIC holds none of these privileges by default, so there is nothing to restore.
changeSet.sql: REVOKE UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE ON bng.audit_log FROM PUBLIC;
